name: Beat Saber: The Weeknd Music Pack
summary:
The levels feature unique light shows, Arc & Chain notes and a beautiful environment for the music pack. The Weeknd Music Pack includes the tracks:

Die For You (Feat. Ariana Grande) (New)
Less Than Zero (New)
Blinding Lights
Can't Feel My Face
How Do I Make You Love Me?
I Feel It Coming (Feat. Daft Punk)
Pray For Me
Sacrifice
Save Your Tears
Starboy (Feat. Daft Punk)
Take My Breath
The Hills
